name: io.github.novigapi/novigapi
title: Novig market data (novigapi.com)
description: Read-only Novig market data: order books, trades, line history, fair prices, +EV and devig.

environmentVariables.name: NOVIGAPI_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Your nv_... key from https://novigapi.com/sign-up. Optional: search, fetch and devig work without it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer nv_... (optional for search, fetch and devig)
